name: Pixture
source:
Main character is a new employee who falls in love with an office lady. Distracted by her legs, he fails the training course. He builds a "Pixture" that is able to manipulate the woman changing her personality the way he wants each new day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位新员工，爱上了一位办公室女士。由于她的双腿分散了他的注意力，他未能通过培训课程。他构建了一个“图片”，能够操纵女人在新的一天按照他想要的方式改变她的性格。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
